name: External API and API keys
summary: The API that partners and autonomous capture systems call without a normal sign-in: the external capture API, the partner progress API, the external asset and category API, and the API keys that unlock them.

roles.note: API keys are not project roles. A partner key and an open API key are configured in the environment, not issued in the product, so no product role can create, see or revoke one (DEC-051). The open-API-key identity carries every permission.

actions.action: Issue, rotate or revoke an API key
Read partner progress data with the partner key
Read or write external assets and categories with an open API key

nfr.statement: The partner progress API accepts at most 100 requests per minute per rate-limit window.
Large external capture uploads, including resumable uploads and simultaneous uploads from several sources.
nfr.open_question: What file sizes, upload frequency and concurrency must the external capture API support?

requirements.title: External capture systems can send captures through an API
requirements.statement: An external capture system can create a capture session with metadata, get upload URLs, upload files that are then checked and processed automatically, receive status updates or webhook notifications, and see the result in the Track3D viewer like any other capture. Incomplete or corrupt uploads are detected and over-limit callers get a clear error.

requirements.title: External capture API sign-in (OAuth or API key)
requirements.statement: The PRD asks for OAuth on the external capture API. Today a caller needs a user sign-in token plus an API key mapped to one project, sent with that project's ID (USER-REQ-013).

dispute.summary: SRC-035 NFR-001 says OAuth with expiring URLs. The gateway instead requires a JWT and a static, environment- configured API key bound to one project. Product and the Tech Architect to choose the partner auth model (DEC-051).

requirements.title: External capture routes exist only in allowed environments
requirements.statement: The external capture routes (register captures, create external captures with metadata only, register a batch of frames, read upload status) are switched on only in environments named in the service configuration. They reuse the normal capture logic.

requirements.title: A progress API authenticated by API key
requirements.statement: Developers can read progress entries for a project, optionally by date, read one entry by ID, and upload new progress entries, authenticating every call with an API key. A missing or invalid key gets 401, an unknown entry 404, malformed data 400, and a query with no data an empty list. API keys are managed and rotated regularly.

requirements.title: External callers see masked IDs
requirements.statement: On the external asset and category routes, Track3D IDs in requests are decoded from masked values, and the category routes mask the IDs they return. The same ID always masks to the same value. A value that can't be decoded is passed on unchanged.
